text:
Oliver: Quick brainstorm  proposed A/B for routing: variant A = latency-weighted routing (current), variant B = cost-aware routing (new). Need rollout plan, canaries, QA gating, and clear rollback criteria.

Hana: Ill own the flag + kill switch. Suggest flag id `route-ab-cost-vs-latency`. :+1:

Jess: Canary idea: dark-replay 20m, then 1% telemetry-only for 1h, then 4% live A/B (50/50) for 2h in NA, then 12% global for 6h. Keep A/B split fixed while measuring quality and cost.

Marco: For Dedicated tenants: default to A (latency) unless customer explicitly opts into B. Add a managed opt-in API for account teams.

Oliver: Draft gating metrics (suggested):
- p99 latency delta (A vs B) <= 18ms
- error-rate absolute change <= 0.03%
- per-token cost change (B vs A) <= -2% (we want cost down) OR at worst <= +4%
- user-facing quality (MRT) delta <= 0.3
- semantic_fidelity score >= 0.6

Jess: We'll need an A/B eval harness that runs live-sampled prompts (1k) and offline seeded eval (2k) each hour. I'll own the harness.

Hana: Flag YAML (ops):
```yaml
flag: route-ab-cost-vs-latency
modes:
  - mode: shadow
    duration: 1200
  - mode: telemetry
    pct: 1
    duration: 3600
  - mode: ab
    pct: 4
    split: [A,B]
    regions: [NA]
    duration: 7200
  - mode: ab
    pct: 12
    split: [A,B]
    regions: [global]
    duration: 21600
manual_targets: [Dedicated]
kill_endpoint: /ops/flags/route-ab-cost-vs-latency/disable
metrics: [p99_latency,error_rate,unit_cost,mrt,semantic_fidelity]
```

Hana: Kill command (runbook):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.redwood.internal/flags/route-ab-cost-vs-latency/disable" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"reason":"emergency rollback","by":"ops"}'
```

ops-bot: Infra check: NA/EU headroom OK. Autoscaler margin=19%. Pre-created alerts for p95/p99 spikes and cost anomalies.

Marco: Preflight: 10m synthetic warmup at 5qps; smoke routing correctness; end-to-end latency sanity tests. Also a shadow compare job that diffs responses and flags >5% semantic mismatches.

Amir: Suggest adding a human hold of 30m after each phase for slow tail signals. Also require manual approval to enable B for Dedicated fleets or to exceed 12% overall.

Jess: Auto-rollback triggers suggestion: if any of these happen comparing B->A: p99 delta > 30ms OR error delta > 0.08% OR MRT drop > 0.5 OR semantic_fidelity < 0.55 => rollback. We should also alert product + oncall loudly before rollback.

Hana: I'll implement ACLs so only ops leads can flip full-global or Dedicated. Auto-up to 12% allowed if gates stay green.

Oliver: Owners & ETA:
- Hana: implement flag, kill endpoint, ACL (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- Jess: A/B harness + seeded eval & live-sample pipelines (ETA: start with telemetry phase)
- Marco: prepare opt-in API + CSM communication draft (ETA: 48 hours)
- Amir/ops-bot: finalize alerts + dashboards (ETA: today)

Amir: Addendum: run a short overlap test where we pin a shadow of B and replay historical traffic to estimate cost delta before live A/B. Low risk and quick.

Marco: Support/CS: I'll draft canned replies explaining A/B and opt-in flow, include rollback guidance and timeline.

Jess: I'll add a semantic drift BLEU-like check and a simple embedding-distance fingerprint for frequent prompts. If drift > 0.6, flag for abort.

Oliver: Decision on automation: hybrid. Auto-increase while gates pass (up to 12%), manual approvals for Dedicated and >12%. Good?

All: +1

Hana: I'll post the runbook link when flag PR merges. Targeting a low-traffic midweek slot next week.

Oliver: Thanks everyone  I'll add owners to the rollout card and request sign-offs.
